text:
Ash Patel: Kickoff — I'm starting the launchpad for asia-east2 GPU region. Primary asks: terraform module update for new gpu pool, pulumi stack naming, and a state sync job to promote the bootstrap state. Who can own the module tweak + CI wiring? :rocket:
Miguel Lopez: I can pick up the TF module changes. Quick q — do we want the state backend in a central bucket or per-region prefix? Last time we had key collisions when teams used inconsistent keys.
Devon Chen: central bucket with per-region prefix. Also we should add a lock table entry in Dynamo to avoid concurrent runs. I'll add a preflight that checks locks.
Serena Brooks: FYI quota ticket is still open: https://tickets.internal/RED-3421 — GPUs currently at 0/50 for asia-east2. We need quota approvals before scale. I linked the quota approver in the ticket.
Paul Nguyen: +1 to prefixing. Suggested terraform backend snippet for reference:
```
terraform {
  backend "s3" {
    bucket = "redwood-infra-state"
    key    = "regions/asia-east2/terraform.tfstate"
    region = "us-west-2"
    dynamodb_table = "redwood-state-locks"
  }
}
```
Ash Patel: perfect, Paul. Miguel — can you add the key naming rule to the module README so future oncalls don't break it?
Miguel Lopez: yep. Also thinking about workspace isolation: we'll have two stacks per region (bootstrap, runtime). Pulumi stacks should follow naming: org/region/env (e.g., redwood/asia-east2/prod).
Devon Chen: here's the pulumi init command we'll use in CI to create the bootstrap stack if missing:
```bash
pulumi stack init redwood/asia-east2/bootstrap || true
pulumi config set aws:region us-east-1 --stack redwood/asia-east2/bootstrap
```
Devon Chen: note — secrets provider MUST be the KMS alias for that region; I'll add the check to the pipeline.
region-provisioner-bot: CI: terraform plan for modules/region-gpu (mr!456) completed with warnings — missing quota check.
Ash Patel: thanks bot. Miguel, can you link your MR to the quota ticket and add a gated job that fails the pipeline if quota check doesn't pass?
Miguel Lopez: will do. Plan to open MR in ~30m. I'll add a job `check-gpu-quota.sh` that calls our quota API and exits 1 if insufficient.
Serena Brooks: also preflight network checklist: VPC peering, private route propagation, NAT capacity. We want BGP routes stable before node boot.
Paul Nguyen: adding to the checklist: ensure subnet tagging matches autoscaler rules and the cluster node role has the right IAM for GPU drivers install. Small script to validate tags:
```bash
aws ec2 describe-subnets --filters "Name=tag:env,Values=prod" "Name=tag=region,Values=asia-east2" --query 'Subnets[].SubnetId'
```
Devon Chen: After modules merged, I'll wire the state-sync job: job reads bootstrap tfstate -> publishes a promoted runtime state in a per-region prefix and sets a promotion flag in SSM. This avoids manual copy steps.
Ash Patel: timeline check — quota approvals expected by EOD. If approvals land, target merge + CI wiring by tomorrow morning and smoke node bring-up post-merge. Can we have a smoke test that validates GPU driver, device visibility, and a sample perf run?
Serena Brooks: yes — I'll sketch the smoke steps and paste them here once done.
Miguel Lopez: MR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge_requests/456 — includes backend naming, README update, and quota check job. Asking for 1 reviewer.
Paul Nguyen: quick note — cost control: add a flag in the module to cap max nodes for initial rollouts (defaults to 5). Let's not accidentally spin up 100 GPUs on day 1.
Ash Patel: excellent catch. Miguel/Devon — please include the cap and an explicit approval step to raise it.
Devon Chen: I'm adding an automated smoke pipeline step that runs a 1-node canary, waits for K8s node Ready, then runs `nvidia-smi` and a tiny perf test. If it passes, we can promote.
region-provisioner-bot: Deploy job queued: region-bootstrap (asia-east2) — awaiting manual approval from @Ash Patel.
Ash Patel: approved when MR is merged and quota green. I'll watch the deploy and jump in if anything flakes. :eyes:
Serena Brooks: I'll update ticket RED-3421 with MR link and smoke plan.
Miguel Lopez: merging now, will ping when pipeline finishes.
Devon Chen: will have the state-sync job ready for the deploy job to call. 
Ash Patel: thanks all — keeping this thread for the timeline. Ping here for any blockers. :white_check_mark:
